name: Klimt Villa
notes: Modern Events Calendar plugin on /veranstaltungen/. First batch of Event JSON-LD is server-rendered; rest comes from paginating the admin-ajax.php action=mec_list_load_more endpoint (params scraped from the inline mecListView({...}) settings block) until it returns count=0. Category isn't in the JSON-LD so one extra GET per event fetches the detail page's breadcrumb/category block (only ~15-20 events total, cheap). Site only publishes ~4.5 months out (through Dec 2026 Adventzauber) even though horizon is 180d.
